visual_review.scope: All changed-row identity crops actually viewed in six plates: recovered pixels lie on the real red/white sphere, excluded old pixels lie on hand/clothing. Selected full-table outbound/target/return source panels and root independent review establish these local trajectories. No whole-video truth or physical subpixel survey is implied.

changes: Only directly source-measured red contour observations recovered, or visually verified body/clothing observations excluded. No predicted/interpolated coordinates and no manually assigned scores.
